description: Lets the grid reveal a local file in the platform file manager. The `remote` block is REQUIRED and not boilerplate: this app does not bundle its frontend (`frontendDist` is a stub) — it serves the UI from `datalib-http` and loads it as an external URL, and Tauri withholds IPC from a remote origin unless that origin is listed. `{{origin}}` is the open library's server, filled in when the library opens (src/library_capabilities.rs), so no other port of this machine gets the app's commands. The pattern is URLPattern syntax and the trailing `/**` matters: the origin alone constrains the pathname to empty and would not match `/` or any route, which fails SILENTLY (the plugin call is simply never authorized). Only the reveal command is granted — `opener:allow-open-path` is deliberately absent, since that one launches a file's default application.
